sentence: He was interested in music from an early age.
synonym: He loved music since he was young
synonymNote: 两者都表示从小就对音乐有浓厚兴趣，意思相同

distractors.note: recently表示最近，与from an early age（从小）意思相反

distractors.word: He was bored with music as a child
distractors.note: bored with表示厌倦，与interested in（感兴趣）意思相反

distractors.word: He learned music only at school
distractors.note: only at school限定了场合，没有表达从小就有兴趣的意思
